protected_screen.flag_rule: hamming<=40 OR correlation>=.95 after aspect/information gate
protected_screen.views: Full, center75%, center50%, four50% corners; eight dihedral orientations on both sides.
protected_screen.limitations: Not complete scene recognition. Different viewpoints, lighting or arbitrary crops may evade comparisons. No training admission by this script; manual source-content review remains separate.
protected_screen.shared_machine: One CPU thread after the packed throughput sweep; model training may be active.

manual_resolution.purpose: Data separation and source quality only; no model/final performance scoring.

decisions.reason: River ferry/sky versus stacked plates/tabletop. Broad dHash OR gate flags smooth horizontal structure; correlations <=.531 and full/partial views show distinct scenes.

manual_resolution.content: Public sources are outdoor landscapes/architecture or the rejected chart. Protected development/final sources show distinct indoor objects/artwork or a distinct close-up fern; the cached train/platform is distinct. All42 reference overviews and all9 candidate overviews inspected; flagged ferry also viewed at full binned-preview size.
manual_resolution.limitations: Manual review plus finite thumbnail/crop identity screening; arbitrary viewpoints or crops can still evade detection. No guarantee of complete scene recognition.

camera_holdouts.standing_scene_policy: GFX100S camera is supported; standing train/platform capture and siblings stay excluded.

trial.status: completed-first1000-and-newmodel-review; small uncertain real gains, mixed synthetic results
